transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’ve been having a harder time keeping my focus at work. Like when I’m scheduling appointments or setting up the lobby displays, I lose my place. My mind kind of drifts to what I might’ve missed or overlooked, and then I have to backtrack.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot?
Yeah… I do. It’s mostly ordinary stuff, like work schedules or bills, travel plans, paperwork. I’ll get stuck thinking one small mistake is going to turn into something bigger.
When you lose focus, is it usually because your mind gets pulled into worries?

Yes… I think so. Like, I’ll be setting up appointments or working on the lobby displays, and then my mind sort of goes to what I might’ve missed. Then I lose my place and have to figure out where I was.
When you lose focus, is it usually because you get caught up in worrying?
Yeah… usually. I’ll be doing something like scheduling appointments or the lobby displays, and then I start thinking about what I might’ve overlooked. Then I kind of lose my spot and have to back up.
When you start worrying, is it hard to stop or control the worry?

Yeah… it can be. I’ll tell myself, like, “Sunny, it’s handled,” but it still keeps going around in my head. Then it turns into another concern, and I end up checking the details over and over in my mind.
When you’re worrying, do you feel physically restless or on edge?
Yeah… I do, I think. I can be at the front desk smiling and helping people, but inside I feel kind of wound tight. Like my shoulders are up and I’m just waiting for something to go wrong.
Do you find yourself worrying about a lot of different parts of your life, not just work?
Yeah… it’s not just work. I worry about regular things too—bills, travel plans, paperwork stuff. Even small mistakes, I start thinking they could turn into something bigger.
Have you been worrying like this more days than not for at least six months?
Yeah… more days than not, I’d say. It’s been about nine months, since that overnight detention and the paperwork mix-up around it.
Do you get muscle tension, like tight shoulders or a clenched jaw?
Yeah… mostly my shoulders. I notice they’re kind of up tight, especially when I’m at the desk. I can still smile and do my job, but inside I feel pretty wound up.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?
I don’t know… not really depressed, I guess. More just tense or worn out sometimes.
